entries.final_answer: Step-level expected_input_artifacts (preconditions) and expected_output_artifacts (postconditions); templates on outputs; the type keeps its own outputs. Every pinned per-step entry is a postcondition (the five class-input entries are spec.md, required at the step that produces it); no pinned pack declares a precondition.

entries.final_answer: The step description in the mission-type file is the description, at most 160 characters (schema maxLength and a domain twin; pinned descriptions run 19 to 119). A prompt keeps its frontmatter description as its detailed description, stored and round-tripped; any other frontmatter key, or guidelines frontmatter, is refused. Sourcing stands: the runtime text first, the prompt frontmatter only where no runtime text exists; such steps are flagged in the open-packs issue. Supersedes the 'prompt frontmatter is not stored' part of plan.q1.
options: keep prompt frontmatter as a detailed description, bound the step description
